title_en: Intermediate English - 42 - How do you feel about expensive weddings?
paras_en: Hello, my name is Roccio and I'm from Columbia. The question is how do you feel about expensive weddings?
That's a really fun question. Well, I'm not against that, but that's not something I would do. Definitely. I
think if you are going to spend a lot of money, you should spend it on yourself, with your partner, take
a long
trip around the world, around Europe if you want. I think a wedding is going to last one day, one
night, and a
long trip can last a month if you want. And you are going to visit new places, you are going to eat different
food, you are going to have amazing experiences. And I think that's much better than having an expensive wedding
for a lot of people.

title_en: Intermediate English - 43 - What do you usually eat for dinner?
paras_en: Hello. My name is Lilith and I'm from Armenia. Today, my question is, what do you usually eat for dinner?
Here in Armenia, we have lots of traditional dishes which are made with meat and are really delicious, but
somehow I happen not to like them. It's probably because all my childhood I've eaten Armenian
traditional food, and I have grown to dislike this kind of food.
So now that I'm lucky to be living alone, I can cook whatever I like. I'm really fond of Italian food.
So for dinner, I usually have either a pasta with some different types of sauce, or some soup, sometimes mashed
potatoes with steak, and occasionally pizza. I really like seafood and fish. So from time to time, I make
some new dishes which include seafood, or fried fish, or fish and chips, and things like that.

title_en: Intermediate English - 44 - What is a TV series you like and what is it about?
paras_en: Hi, my name is Rocio, and I'm from Colombia. The question is what is a TV series you like and what is it about?

Well, I have a lot of favorite series, a lot, but right now I'm watching Killing Eve. I love that series, I think it's just incredible. You know, it's about an assassin and sort of like an officer, a detective, and they kind of chase each other, and it's wonderful. I love it. The series has, I think, three seasons, and every season has less than 10 episodes. It's incredible, I really love it. It's one of my favorite series so far, and it's one of the best series I've seen in the last years.

title_en: Intermediate English - 46 - Do you belong to a group or community?
paras_en: Hi. My name is Nev, and I'm from Canada. My question for today is do you belong to a group or community?

And unfortunately I don't, not because I have anything about being a part of a group or community. It's only because I've been traveling a lot over the past six years now. So I haven't really had the chance to be somewhere long enough to become a member of a group or part of a community.

If I were to become one, and hopefully I will in the future, I would like to join communities that help people around us, communities that offer services for let's say homeless people or people who are struggling when it comes to their mental health or things like that. So I think it would be great to give something back to the community and to be a part of something useful.
What do you think? Would you consider being a part of a community? Unless you already are.

title_en: Intermediate English - 46 - What sports do you like to play?
paras_en: Hi, my name is Rocio, and I'm from Colombia. The question is what sports do you like to play?

Well, when I was younger, I really loved a sport called kicking ball. It's like baseball, but instead of hitting, it's kicking with foot, it's really fun. I played that sport for years. I also like volleyball. I think it's really fun, you know, on the beach or whatever. It's really cool. Right now, I don't play those sports, but I go to the gym every single day, you know, lifting weights. I do CrossFit. I do functional training. I think exercise, you know, sports, moving, it's the best thing you can do for yourself or your health. And yeah, I train every single day of my life.

title_en: What did you do last night?
paras_en: Hi everyone. My name is Jill and I'm from Australia. And my question today is, what did you do last night?

I had a really fun night last night. I got to meet with some friends that I hadn't seen in a while, so my friend cooked dinner for us, and so we went to her place and we sat together, we ate all of the food, and we talked, we laughed and we danced a little all through the night. She made a beautiful dish with mushroom rice and chicken and potatoes, and afterwards we helped clean, so we vacuumed her living room. We cleaned the dishes, and then we decided that we wanted some dessert. And so we walked to the nearest bubble tea shop where we laughed so much that we were scared we were going to get kicked out, but we didn't. And so we sat, we laughed, we talked, and then I had to say goodnight and come home for the evening.
What about you? What did you do last night? Did you do anything fun?

title_en: Intermediate English - 48 - What is your favorite movie?
paras_en: Hello, my name is Rocio and I'm from Colombia. The question is what is your favorite movie?

Well, I have a lot of favorite movies. It's a little bit hard to pick one, but one of my favorites, it always have been a movie called Love Actually. Love Actually is a Christmas romantic comedy film. It's about 10 different and separate stories and the different types of love and relationships, you know, married couples, a father and a son, friends. I've always loved it. I love Christmas movies because I love Christmas. And I think I watch Love Actually every December. It's such a pretty movie. I love it. I watch it with my mom or with my family for Christmas, and we all love it.

title_en: Intermediate English - 49 - Is trash recycled in your country?
paras_en: Hi, my name is Sarah. I come from England, and my question is, is trash recycled in your country?

So the answer to that is yes. We definitely do recycle in England. It is starting to thankfully get a lot more serious and, you know, people are really starting to recycle more, especially since now, I think that you can be fined quite a lot of money if you don't recycle properly in the U.K. As of now, I think we have three different types of trash that mainly get recycled: plastic, glass, and cardboard, I believe are the three different things that we recycle right now.

We also have, like, three different trash cans, which are different colors to help you remember which type of trash goes into which type of trash can. And yeah, then the garbage guy will come and collect it, take it away, and they are separated, which makes it easier to recycle and to better help the environment.
So yeah, we definitely do recycle in England.
Hi everyone. My name is Jill and I'm from Australia. And my question today is, what are you wearing today?

I'm actually really excited to answer this question because I am wearing my new favorite T-shirt, and it is from my most recent holiday. It is the shade of green that I love the most because it reminds me of the forest, and it says on here, you can either fight it or ride it, and it has a picture of a girl who is riding a wave, which is perfect because on this holiday I went on a surfing camp. I'm also wearing today a necklace that I always wear with me. And this necklace is really special because one thing about me is that I love to travel, and on this necklace are little trinkets, which I have collected from all of my travels. For example, the shell is from Spain. This little glass pendant is from Italy, and this silver key is from India. And I am wearing this today, and I wear this every day because it reminds me of happy memories that I had from when I was traveling.
What about you? What are you wearing today?
And do they hold any special meaning to you?
Hi, I'm Stacy. I am Australian and I live in Scotland. And my question is, what is my first job?

My first job was actually working in McDonald's. I was 18. I had just finished school. It's actually really good first job, especially in Australia. I find if you've got McDonald's as your first job in your CV as a reference, it really holds up.

It was good fun. Most of the people that work there are sort of age between, I would say 15 to 25, so really sociable and yeah, you get really good experience and you can work with people and customers, and you do come home smelling like french fries. You've got to come home and have a shower. You also tend to get a bit of an oily skin from being around the frying machine, but I also learned to work at the back in the kitchen, which is also really good fun and just a change of pace from serving customers.
But yeah, I did it for a year and a half while I was at university, and it was a really good first job.

title_en: Where does your best friend live?
paras_en: Hi, I'm Olivia. I'm from Washington DC and my question is, where does your best friend live?

My best friend lives in New York City right now. We are childhood best friends. I've known her probably since I was five, and we were best friends since we were eight, and we both loved where we grew up, but did not see ourselves living there. So I moved to London and she moved to New York City, and I really hope that one day we end up living in the same city together.

I also want to live in New York City, and she also kind of wants to live in London, and so hopefully one of us makes the choice to go somewhere and we might be able to live there together because texting and calling isn't the same as being there with the person. So she loves New York City, though that's honestly where she's thriving and she's doing really well. She's got a great job, so I'm really proud of her, but I do miss her and I do wish that we were in the same location.

title_en: Do you have a special pet?
paras_en: The question I'm answering is, do I have a special pet?

And yes, I do have a special pet, and his name is Cooper. So, Cooper is a dog that we have, and he's of the breed King Charles Cavalier. The King Charles Cavalier were bred to be companion dogs, and they have a mild temperament and are good with children, but our dog that's quite special is nothing like that.

He runs around, he pulls; he's a bit aggressive. He would jump all over you, but we don't mind because he's our special dog. Now he has white and brown fur, and this mix is usually called a Blenheim color, and he loves to eat everything. He chews different parts of the house. He'll eat your socks. But we still love him because he is our special pet.
